about.en: NVIDIA (Ondo Tokenized) (NVDAon) is an Ondo tokenized stock issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform, giving eligible non-US holders economic exposure to NVIDIA Corporation shares (NVDA). It is fully backed by the underlying security and is a total return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x2d1f7226bd1f780af6b9a49dcc0ae00e8df4bdee, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
